sessions.text:
User: I want to tidy up how I write docs for my tools.
Assistant: Sure. Which format do you usually write in?
User: I prefer Markdown for documentation. Also, always use British spelling in prose.
Assistant: Got it. I'll default to Markdown and use British spelling.
User: Thanks, that's all for now.

User: I've just joined Project Borealis, a data catalogue for the research office.
Assistant: Welcome. Is there a documentation setup already?
User: For Project Borealis, write the docs in reStructuredText because Sphinx builds our site.
Assistant: Understood. For Project Borealis I'll write reStructuredText.
User: Great. Catch you later.

User: Quick follow-up on Project Borealis docs.
Assistant: Go ahead.
User: Actually, for Project Borealis, switch to AsciiDoc because we are moving the site to Antora.
Assistant: Noted. Project Borealis docs will use AsciiDoc from now on.
User: Thanks. That's everything.
